name: Circle of Sleep
description: Forms a 5x5 circle; bugs inside accumulate 2 stacks of Drowsy each turn (doesn't fade while inside). Drowsy = -1 die to non-Soak rolls, and another -1 per 3 stacks. If Drowsy reaches 6 and the bug is out of combat, it falls asleep until the spell ends. Violent actions wake sleeping bugs (they keep stacks). Spending 1 Essence during casting makes friendly bugs immune.

name: Disguise
description: Gives the target a new appearance chosen by the caster, increasing Creep or Cute by up to 2, or copies the appearance of a sensed individual (gaining their Creep/Cute). While active, caster may spend 1 Essence to burn the disguise into a brief mirage: during the mirage the caster may use Insight instead of Grace to dodge and inflict -1 die penalty to targets' parry and dodge.

name: Illusion
description: Creates an image up to one square in size that may animate, emit light/sound, and move with Speed 4 on caster's turn. Touching it reveals its nature. Spending 1 extra Soul increases dimensions by one square. Spending 1 Essence when casting can make the illusion visible only to select targets within Sense range.

name: Mirror Ally
description: Creates a translucent reflection of the target elsewhere in range. The Mirror Ally has base stats, traits and equipment of the target except Charms/consumables; no Arts, path ranks, or special abilities, but shares caster's attuned spells. Heart = 2 on appearance; acts after caster in initiative. Controlled by caster; shares tax, Focus actions, Soul and Stamina with caster. Spending 1 Essence during casting allows the Ally to use one Art, spell, rank-1 path, or special ability the target knows.

name: Read Mind
description: Contested Insight; on success the caster reads the target's surface thoughts for the duration, including immediate intentions; target cannot successfully lie. Spending 1 Essence also allows the caster to silently ask a yes/no question or open two-way communication without the target's knowledge.

name: Semicorporeality
description: Makes the target partially within the Dream: non-magic damage to the target is halved (rounded down, min 1); non-magic damage by the target is halved (rounded up). Target can see/interact with Dream Spirits as if corporeal. Whenever an attack is made by/against the target in Sense range, the caster may spend 1 Essence to make that attack deal normal damage.

name: Speak with Dreams
description: Gathers Dream fragments from a corpse to create a pseudo-spirit that can speak and answer questions. Spending 1 Essence allows casting on a sleeping target to speak within their dream; targets tend to forget and believe ideas as their own. Other Essence users are aware of the intrusion.
